title: Read realized performance history
description: Read how a pipeline's models performed against real outcomes, one row per model per validated prediction date, newest date first. Each row has realized AUC with a 95% interval, Brier score, calibration error, quantile calibration bins, mean_p_y against base_rate (mean_p_y above base_rate means the model over-predicts), lift at 10% and 20%, the ISO weekday, and the model's role when it emitted and now. Use it to see trends across dates and to judge a champion right after a promotion: the archived former champion keeps its rows, while the new champion has none until its first horizon elapses. A wide AUC interval means the date had few positives. Rows exist only after a prediction horizon has elapsed and online validation has run. Use limit to bound the number of dates (default 60).

methodDocumentation.text: Return the realized metrics online validation recorded for each model on each validated prediction date, newest date first. Each row has realized AUC with a 95% interval, Brier score, calibration error, quantile calibration bins, mean predicted probability against the base rate, lift, and the model's role when it emitted and now. The rows come from the validation runs, so a former champion that a promotion archived keeps its history. Read-only; it runs no queries.
